frontmatter.description: Independent systematic review screener for any clinical domain and meta-analysis. Performs both Title & Abstract (first-pass) and Full-text (second-pass) screening of RIS files against a user-uploaded protocol. Uses ASReview (active learning, pip-installable from PyPI) as the primary screening engine. Enriches every NCT number found in the RIS file with live ClinicalTrials.gov API v2 data (free, no key required): confirms study design, rescues sparse/missing abstracts, detects protocol papers, and feeds
